description: Ministry of Defence - Award the Videsha Sewa Padakama to the Air Force officer D. M. S. B. Dassanayaka wa. cdr.  duration from 05.11.2017 to 04.11.2018
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the award of the Videsha Sewa Padakkama to a specific named individual (Wg Cdr DMSB Dassanayaka) by the President. It contains personnel information (award to a specific person) but does not include any detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities, ministerial assignments, or government structural changes. The content focuses solely on recognizing an individual's service, fitting the criteria for Type 2 (People Gazette).
